info.title: Project Atlas API
info.description: Multi-tenant CBT platform API. Error envelope and idempotency contract: ADR-0033.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable code. Clients branch on this, never on `message`.

message.description: Human-readable — for logs/debugging, not client branching.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the same request (with the same Idempotency-Key, if it had one) could succeed. F13's offline sync queue decides retry-vs-drop from this.

correlationId.description: Correlates this response to server-side logs.

details.description: Present for some error codes — e.g. VALIDATION_ERROR's failing fields.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: ADR-0033: a client-generated UUIDv7, one per logical mutating operation (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE). A replay of the same key returns the original response unchanged; the same key with a different request body is rejected with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REPLAY_MISMATCH (409), never a silent overwrite. Optional per endpoint — GET/HEAD ignore it entirely.
